section_summary.extract_value: This procedural section describes a study in which female introductory psychology students were recruited from a university Department of Psychology to participate in exchange for class credit. Participants completed measures in a classroom research lab setting, with measures counterbalanced to control for order effects. The study investigated body attitudes, personality characteristics, and eating behavior with anonymous responses.
